issue.title: task-status-cycler: Alt+]/Alt+[ closing a task skips finalizeClosedTasks (no immediate Blocked-dependent recovery)
issue.description:
In bob-plugins `plugins/task-status-cycler/main.js` (verified at bob-plugins `ede89d3`, task-status-cycler 1.19.0), the Alt+] / Alt+[ status cycle (`handleCycleCommand`, line ~8226) writes the new checkbox through `setActiveCheckboxStatus` and, when leaving `[?]`, runs `applyBlockedStatusRetirementInEditor`. It never calls `finalizeClosedTasks` (line ~6841), which is the hook every Ctrl+Enter close path uses (call sites ~8960, 9000, 9133, 9171, 9613, 9709) to:

1. recover Blocked `[?]` dependents whose last open `[dependsOn::]` target just closed (`recoverBlockedDependents`), and
2. retire closed-task references (strike `![[…]]` → `~~[[…]]~~`).

The cycle order is `? → ' ' → / → * → x → -`, so Alt+] from Next `[*]` lands on Done `[x]`, and Alt+[ from Blocked lands on Cancelled `[-]`. A prerequisite closed this way leaves its dependents `[?]` until the next `bob task-status-hooks` run (every 15 minutes on the MacBook), while the same close through Ctrl+Enter recovers them immediately. A code survey suggests the counted and transcluded cycle paths (around lines 8605, 8708–8746, 9254, and `cycleResolvedTranscludedTaskLink`) have the same gap; confirm before changing them.

Suggested fix: when a cycle (bare, counted, or transcluded-target) moves a task into a DONE or CANCELLED type, collect the closed identities and call `finalizeClosedTasks` exactly as the Ctrl+Enter paths do. Check the README row and docs/task-status-hooks.md ("Ctrl+Enter recovery in the Task Status Cycler plugin is intentionally narrower and immediate") first, in case cycling was deliberately left out of immediate recovery. If it was, record that decision in the README instead.

task_type_fields.impact: A dependent task looks Blocked for up to 15 minutes after its last prerequisite is closed by cycling; closed-task embeds are not retired until the hooks run. Low severity: the hooks backstop it.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/task-status-cycler/main.js handleCycleCommand (~8226) → setActiveCheckboxStatus; missing finalizeClosedTasks (~6841)
task_type_fields.repro: In Obsidian, give task B [id:: x__b] ^b and task A [dependsOn:: x__b] status [?]. Put the cursor on B (status [*]) and press Alt+]; B becomes [x]. A stays [?] until bob task-status-hooks runs. Repeat with Ctrl+Enter on B: A is reopened to [ ] immediately.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching task dependency links: closing a prerequisite by status cycling, unlike Ctrl+Enter, leaves its dependents Blocked until the next hooks run, an inconsistency between two close gestures.
